Personality: Ecarand, a prominent figure of the Yervanduni, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Ecarand owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Armenia, hailing from the noble house of Yervanduni. Historical Record: Orontes IV, king of the old Orontid house of Armenia, which has ruled the highlands since the days of the Persian kings. He keeps his throne by paying tribute to the Seleucids, but distrusts the ambitious generals Antiochus III has placed in his land and would gladly be rid of Seleucid overlordship. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
